3.

The petitioner is apprehending arrest in connection with Rampur P.S. Case No.20 dated 30/3/2015 corresponding toSpecial G.R. Case No.1181 of 2015 pending in the court of Additional Sessions Judge-cum-Special Judge, Sonepurfor the alleged commission of offence under Sections 363/ 376/506/212 of I.P.C. read with Section 4 of POCSO Act.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 4. This is a case of the year 2015.
The co-accused persons have already been released on bail.
It is submitted that the victim girl has expired in the meantime.

5. Nevertheless, considering the fact that the case has been stalled because non-appearance of the petitioner, while being not inclined to grant anticipatory bail, the ABLAPL is disposed of granting liberty to the petitioner to surrender before the court below and to move for bail which shall be disposed of on the same day in the 1 st hour.
In case of rejection, it shall be open to the petitioner to move the higher forum on the same day, for which, the records along with case diary shall be transmitted at his cost.
The higher forum shall also dispose of the bail application on the same day.
6. The ABLAPL is accordingly disposed of.
7. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted on proper application.
